body:
The design is very straightforward, which I really appreciate. It also gives me the flexibility to customize my notes—whether that’s drawing, inserting photos, or aligning the content with my goals.

I do have a suggestion, though. I hope there could be an option to view notes in a “read-only” mode, where no changes can be made unless the Edit button is specifically clicked.
